description.zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，取值范围为1~100。
description.en: The page number of the returned results to display. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify this ID; otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.  

></notice>  

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值不超过100。
description.en: The number of records to return per page. The maximum value is 100.

description.zh: 传入解析器名称中任意字符串，根据该字符串检索能匹配的解析器名称。
description.en: A string contained in a resolver name. The system retrieves resolver names that match this string.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 10.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot list-parser --iot-instance-id iot-n8t0000 --page-size 10 --search-name DataParser --current-page 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
